scope: Migrate the two Light-owned lighttpd runtime paths and its matching web-publish ownership receipt as one journaled lifecycle operation; preserve exact old config/receipt bytes and modes for rollback and interrupted recovery.
invariants: Validate accepted native-auth/publication ownership and exact old config hash before changes
Change only PID/log paths, not bind/auth/session settings
Store configuration rollback state as a durable transaction record, never download scratch
Publish each verified config through a same-filesystem rename; service startup waits for the pair
Refuse missing/ambiguous ownership rather than adopt foreign config
